Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
i,o=G['Demo pair 2 input'],G['Demo pair 2 output']
L=[r[:7] for r in i]; R=[r[8:] for r in i]
thm=[[1 if o[r][c]==3 else 0 for c in range(7)] for r in range(5)]
pred=[[1 if (L[r][c]!=R[r][c]) and (L[r][c] in (6,) or R[r][c] in (8,)) else 0 for c in range(7)] for r in range(5)]
for p,r_ in zip(pred,thm): print(p); print(r_)
print('match:', pred==thm)
# what cells predicted but not: values
extra=[(r,c,L[r][c],R[r][c]) for r in range(5) for c in range(7) if pred[r][c]==1 and thm[r][c]==0]
missing=[(r,c,L[r][c],R[r][c]) for r in range(5) for c in range(7) if pred[r][c]==0 and thm[r][c]==1]
print('extra:',extra); print('missing:',missing)

import numpy as np, os, re, json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    D=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(D+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(D)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); GG={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in GG and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            GG[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return GG
GG=load()
for n in range(1,9):
    I=np.array(GG[f'Demo pair {n} input']); O=np.array(GG[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    th,bw=O.shape; h,w=I.shape
    bg=Counter(I.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find separator column/row: uniform non-bg col or row
    sep=None
    for s in range(w):
        col=list(set(map(int,I[:,s])))
        if len(col)==1 and col[0]!=bg: sep=('col',s); break
    if sep is None:
        for s in range(h):
            row=list(set(map(int,I[s,:])))
            if len(row)==1 and row[0]!=bg: sep=('row',s); break
    axis,val=sep
    if axis=='col': A=I[:,:val]; B=I[:,val+1:]
    else: A=I[:val]; B=I[val+1:]
    tagA=Counter(A.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]; tagB=Counter(B.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    na={(r,c) for r in range(A.shape[0]) for c in range(A.shape[1]) if A[r,c]!=tagA}
    nb={(r,c) for r in range(B.shape[0]) for c in range(B.shape[1]) if B[r,c]!=tagB}
    ou=set(map(tuple,np.where(O==3)))
    # translation candidates: shift nb onto na bbox origin (dr = anchor top-left alignment)
    # try aligning nb bbox to na bbox
    mr=min(p[0] for p in na); mc=min(p[1] for p in na)
    nmr=min(p[0] for p in nb); nmc=min(p[1] for p in nb)
    dr,nmr_shift=nr,nc=nmr-mc  # placeholder
    ok=[]
    for M,S2 in ((na,nb),(nb,na)):
        pts=S2
        # translate so min point lands at min point of M's offset within canvas
        mrm=min(p[0] for p in M); mrc=min(p[1] for p in M)
        dr_=mrm-min(p[0] for p in pts)
        dc_=mrc-min(p[1] for p in pts)
        S={(r+dr_,c+dc_) for r,c in pts}
        inter=S&M
        ok.append((M is na, dr_, dc_, sorted(inter), sorted(ou), len(inter)==len(ou), sorted(inter)==sorted(ou)))
    print(n,'out size',O.shape,'noise A:',len(na),'B:',len(nb))
    for item in ok: print('   ',item)

steps.input:
def gethalves(I):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for s in range(h):
        if len(set(I[s]))==1 and I[s][0]!=bg:
            A=[[I[i][j] for j in range(w)] for i in range(s)]
            B=[[I[i][j] for j in range(w)] for i in range(s+1,h)]
            cntL=Counter(x for r in A for x in r); cntR=Counter(x for r in B for x in r)
            if cntL.most_common(1)[0][0]!=cntR.most_common(1)[0][0]: return ('row',s,A,B)
    for s in range(w):
        col=[I[i][s] for i in range(h)]
        if len(set(col))==1 and col[0]!=bg:
            LA=[[I[i][j] for j in range(s)] for i in range(h)]
            LB=[[I[i][j] for j in range(s+1,w)] for i in range(h)]
            cntL=Counter(x for r in LA for x in r); cntR=Counter(x for r in LB for x in r)
            if cntL.most_common(1)[0][0]!=cntR.most_common(1)[0][0]: return ('col',s,LA,LB)
    return None
for n in range(1,9):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    res=gethalves(I); ax,s,A,B=res
    H,W=len(A),len(A[0])
    cntL=Counter(x for r in A for x in r); cntR=Counter(x for r in B for x in r)
    na=tuple((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if A[i][j]!=cntL.most_common(1)[0][0])
    nb=tuple((i,j) for i in range(len(B)) for j in range(len(B[0])) if B[i][j]!=cntR.most_common(1)[0][0])
    o3=tuple((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if O[i][j]==3)
    print(f'demo{n}: split {ax}{s} A dom={cntL.most_common(1)[0][0]} noise={na}')
    print('       B dom=%s noise=%s  out3=%s'%(cntR.most_common(1)[0][0],nb,o3))

import os,re,numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
